title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E07 — MK-Ultra Revealed
The CIA's MK-Ultra program sought to create mind control methods through unethical human experimentation, and now, experts investigate classified documents that reveal the horrific atrocities that were carried out in the pursuit of national security.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E01 — Terror of Nazi Propaganda
After seizing power in 1933, Adolf Hitler began systematically transforming a peaceful German population into a ruthless war machine; experts investigate the innovative methods used by the Nazis to indoctrinate and control the will of its citizens.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E02 — The Devil's Bible
"The Codex Gigas," also known as the "Devil's Bible," is a giant medieval tome that has evoked fear for centuries and is believed to contain a malevolent power; experts investigate its legendary secrets and uncover the mystery behind its author.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E03 — Mary Magdalene Enigma
Mary Magdalene played a pivotal role in early Christianity and witnessed the execution and resurrection of Jesus Christ; experts investigate the truth behind her mysterious disappearance and embark on a quest to locate her undiscovered remains.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E04 — Secrets of Gobekli Tepe
The ancient site of Göbekli Tepe is the oldest building complex ever discovered and continues to baffle archaeologists; experts investigate new theories behind its construction as a possible commemoration to a cataclysmic event.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
Noah's Ark: The Endless Quest
Explorers investigate the snow-covered Ararat Mountains for remains of Noah's Ark; two separate expeditions claim discoveries in different areas, fueling debates over the truth of the story.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
The Ten Plagues: A Greek Curse?
The ten plagues of Egypt are supposedly sent by God to convince Pharaoh to free the Israelites; some scientists link these events to a volcanic eruption or climate change; could these be natural occurrences or are they divine warnings?

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
El Dorado: Gold, Guns and Greed
El Dorado, the legendary city of gold, captivated Europeans in the 16th and 17th centuries, sparking endless quests for hidden treasures; fueled by greed, these expeditions led to the loss of countless lives.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
The Incas: A Sudden Fall
In 1532, Spanish conquistadors encounter the advanced Inca Empire; despite their sophisticated infrastructure, the Inca falls within decades; the story of how a powerful empire is overtaken by a small group of conquistadors remains mysterious.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
Ancient Rome: Fall or Pushed?
The Roman Empire fell in the year 476, yet questions linger; did it truly fall or does it continue as the Byzantine Empire? What caused its demise? The debate remains controversial even among modern historians.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
Ramses II: The Greatest Pharaoh
Rameses II led Egypt through a sixty-year golden age as a powerful pharaoh; despite his recorded achievements, researchers investigate lingering mysteries regarding his wife Nefertari and his death.

description:
S01 E04 — Black Knight Rises
A piece of the sun seems to have vanished; the Hubble spots an unidentified object traveling faster than light.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S03 E04 — Ghosts on a Comet
When a Chinese moon rover breaks down, a scientist at NASA points to a mysterious material that seemed to sabotage the Apollo missions decades earlier; the Rosetta spacecraft discovers a comet that appears to be singing.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S03 E03 — Rise of the Ice Creatures
Neil Armstrong enters an unexplained spin; an Apollo 17 photo seems to show a US military outpost on the Moon; possible alien life swimming in the oceans of Jupiter's moons.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S07 E05 — Secret World of Nebulas
Nebulas are the strange structures of cosmic gas and dust where stars are born and die, and new discoveries reveal the secrets of these mysterious places.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S07 E10 — Cassini's Final Secrets
For twenty years, NASA's Cassini spacecraft revealed the strange secrets of Saturn until it vaporized in its atmosphere in a blaze of glory; but today its legacy lives on, as fresh data from the probe helps scientists make brand-new discoveries.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Assassination Sphere
A minuscule metal sphere containing two microscopic holes could be the smallest murder weapon in history; experts explore how this tiny object is linked to one of the most bizarre true crime cases of the 20th century.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Macabre Hat of Teeth
A museum in South London contains a disturbing tattered hat made of brown felt and decorated with more than 80 human teeth; using the latest imaging technology, experts investigate to uncover the macabre origins of this mysterious Victorian-era cap.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Psychograph
Investigating whether a machine can read personalities; an ancient golden mask painted with human blood; a cursed chicken pot.

title: Strangest Things
description:
Phineas Gage's Skull
The shattered skull of a 19th century railway worker is now one of the most astonishing objects in the history of medical science; experts explore this traumatic injury to reveal how it changed the field of neuroscience.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Dixon Relics
A stone sphere, a hook and five fragments of wood are the only objects ever discovered inside the Great Pyramid of Giza; experts investigate if they can explain the mysteries behind the only surviving Wonder of the Ancient World.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Jericho Head
In 1953, a team of archaeologists uncovers a bizarre, plastered human skull in the ancient city of Jericho; experts investigate the mysterious purpose and identity behind this 9,000-year-old clay-covered artifact.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Mask of Agamemnon
Investigating whether a gold death mask is the face of a king who fought in the Trojan Wars; three ancient chalk carvings could be the secret to constructing Stonehenge; how a printing plate from the UK Treasury ended up in an Austrian lake.

title: UFOs: The Lost Evidence
description:
S02 E01 — Nazi UFO Secrets
Evidence reveals the development of secret Nazi weapons not long after an alleged UFO crashed in Germany's Black Forest; UFO experts investigate whether the U.S. government co-opted this technology for its own space and military programs.

title: UFOs: The Lost Evidence
description:
S02 E06 — American UFO Coverups
UFO sightings have been caught on film across the United States, yet the government continues to deny the existence of extraterrestrials; recent news of the Pentagon's secret UFO program may reveal evidence of what the military has known for decades.

title: UFOs: The Lost Evidence
description:
S02 E04 — UFO Tech
An exploration into whether breakthroughs such as high-energy lasers, antigravity technology and super-advanced aircraft are the result of human efforts alone or contact with UFOs.

title: UFOs: The Lost Evidence
description:
S02 E03 — UFO Abduction
Although alien abduction claims are often dismissed as hoaxes or delusions, there are landmark cases that scholars struggle to refute; Calvin Parker retells his harrowing experience of being abducted near the Pascagoula River in Mississippi.

title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
description:
S01 E01 — You Saw a UFO
After the death of his father, a farmer believes he witnessed a UFO; a geologist uncovers debris at the Roswell crash site; after seeing an orb in the sky, a mother suffers radiation-like burns on her body.

title: UFOs: The Lost Evidence
description:
S02 E08 — Extraterrestrials and Sacred Sites
Evidence suggests contact with interstellar travelers in the distant past may have influenced humankind and many of its sacred sites.

description:
S01 E05 — Interstellar Gold Rush
A distant planet shows an Earth-like atmosphere; a glowing light suggests an atmosphere on the Moon; why there are blueberries on Mars.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S03 E06 — Curse of the Red Planet
Three cosmonauts mysteriously die as they re-enter Earth's atmosphere and NASA needs to know why; a declassified document shows a CIA plan to use a space disaster as a cover to start World War 3.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S03 E05 — The Moon that Disappeared
Recently discovered documents show NASA's secret plan B for failure of the first moon landing; a Soyuz capsule carrying NASA astronaut Peggy Whitson back to Earth goes missing; NASA's Cassini mission unravels a three-hundred-year-old.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S07 E02 — When Supernovas Strike
Supernovas are the violent death of giant stars, and new discoveries reveal that these cataclysmic events create the elements that are essential to all life in the universe.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S07 E06 — Did the Big Bang Really Happen?
New discoveries cause astronomers to question if the Big Bang really happened; using the latest science, they investigate if it wasn't just the start of the universe but many mysterious multiverses.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S08 E03 — Hunt for Alien Evidence
The discovery of extraterrestrial life might face an impossible challenge: the physics of the universe itself; using cutting-edge tech, experts might be on the verge of a groundbreaking find, and the evidence could already be in hand.

title: Alaska Mega Machines
description:
S01 E05 — Warriors in the Last Frontier
A barge carries an entire train along Alaska's high seas; a flying ambulance saves lives at 14,000 feet; 16 missiles stand by to prevent a nuclear disaster.

title: Alaska Mega Machines
description:
S01 E06 — Behemoths of the Bush
An airport made from nothing but water and ice; an Alaskan fish factory churns out millions of pounds of seafood a day; hardy vehicles brave the arctic to travel across the tundra.

title: Alaska Mega Machines
description:
S01 E03 — Gargantuan off the Grid
Alaskan engineers build a massive dam to power an entire town; the world's largest helicopters; Alaska's largest boat lift hauls a 400-ton fishing ship in high winds.

title: Alaska Mega Machines
description:
S01 E01 — Beasts of the Arctic
A ship built to endure tsunami size waves travels on a highway unlike any other in North America; a fleet of machines combats a huge flood in the Arctic Circle; the biggest, most powerful wind turbines in Alaska.

title: Alaska Mega Machines
description:
S01 E02 — The Yeti Strikes Back
The Yeti, a machine with 588 sharp teeth, helps keep an airport running; tugboats break the ice in an Alaskan port; soldiers stationed at the coldest army post in the US.

title: Alaska Mega Machines
description:
S01 E04 — Bering Sea Giants
Alaska's Coast Guard fights dangerous waters to maintain buoys; machinery finds big rewards 800 feet below Alaska's surface; Alaskans build a steel ferry.

title: Modern Warfare 2.0
description:
S01 E01 — Future Soldier
Electronic warfare, drones and AI-driven soldiers define modern combat. Learn more about the digitized battlefield with enhanced soldiers, killer robots and lethal autonomous weapons.

title: Modern Warfare 2.0
description:
S01 E02 — Death From Above
Originally for reconnaissance, drones now carry missiles and bombs; the Reaper, a hunter-killer, exemplifies advanced tech and our path towards AI; exploring unmanned warfare.

title: Modern Warfare 2.0
description:
S01 E03 — Shock and Awe
Directed energy weapons, once only seen in science fiction, are now reality. They can disable cities' circuits and destroy missiles, heralding space warfare.

title: Modern Warfare 2.0
description:
S01 E04 — The Unseen Fear
Despite bans, dangerous chemical weapons are still used by certain regimes. Explore how these weapons are used and how they can possibly contribute to the threat of future biological warfare.

title: Modern Warfare 2.0
description:
S01 E05 — Digital Doomsday
Weapons of mass destruction now include chemical, hypersonic and cyber threats. Like any weapon, cyberattacks can cripple nations, threatening society's survival.

title: Manhattan Project: Mysteries at the Museum
description: Don Wildman investigates the story behind the creation of the first atomic bomb, examining the secret cities, high stakes and Earth-shattering decisions that would bring the world's greatest scientific minds together and change history forever.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S03 E08 — Attack of the Thunderballs
Astronauts evacuate when a mystery object hurtles toward the ISS; a NASA secret agent goes undercover to retrieve missing moon rocks; scientists struggle to find answers when they discover a huge void at the edge of the solar system.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S03 E07 — Red Storm Rising
Two astronauts trapped in the vacuum of space face a horrible death; the first close up images of Pluto show an alien landscape; residents of Houston struggle to explain videos of unidentified flying lights captured above their city at night.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S07 E01 — Nightmares of Neutron Stars
Neutron stars are strange and violent phenomena that defy the laws of physics, and new discoveries reveal that these bizarre nightmares are far more deadly than previously believed, with the power to destroy planets and even other stars.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S07 E07 — Battle of the Dark Universe
Dark matter and dark energy are locked in an epic battle for control of the cosmos, and the winner will determine the fate of the universe; new discoveries might reveal which force will emerge victorious.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E12 — The Ruins of Archaeopolis
This decaying fortress once stood between the Ancient Roman and Persian Empires; though the stronghold's location attracted great wealth, it also attracted attention from unfriendly neighbors.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E10 — The Ruins of Troy
In modern-day Turkey, on the coast of the Aegean Sea, archaeologists discovered hilltop ruins that are believed to be the site of one of the world's most enduring stories -- the legend of Troy and the Trojan Horse.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E08 — Turkish Wonderland
In the Turkish capital, ambitious plans for a new amusement park are disrupted by financial, mechanical and political problems, forcing the park to close; now its old roller coasters stand as symbols of excess on the city skyline.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E11 — Hell Island
On a picturesque island off the coast of Brazil, this penal colony was once the site of a dramatic prisoner uprising; among the ruins lies the story of the violent rebellion and the recapturing of the island by military forces.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E13 — Korea's Joan of Arc
A teenage girl in Korea is martyred in prison and becomes a national hero; the facility where she was held stands in remembrance of her bravery and the Korean struggle for independence.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E06 — Blues Prison
Formerly known as one of the toughest prisons in America, this massive complex was once home to medical experiments and a chaotic hostage situation; it's better remembered as the setting for the iconic opening scene of "The Blues Brothers."

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S10 E09 — The Montauk Conspiracy
Conspiracies swirl around an abandoned military base in Long Island, where it's alleged that covert government experiments took place underground; experts discuss the critical role that the base played in defending America's coastline.

title: Conspiracies Decoded
description:
S01 E09 — Hitler's Escape Enigma
Adolph Hitler disappears from the world in an apparent suicide at the end of World War II, but theories of his possible escape continue to circulate; experts use forensic science to examine remains that could finally solve the mystery of his fate.

title: Conspiracies Decoded
description:
S01 E03 — Nazi Doomsday Project
Brand-new evidence reveals the secrets of a Nazi program to build a nuclear bomb; using cutting-edge science and technology, experts uncover classified files that reveal how close Hitler came to this terrifying super weapon.

title: Conspiracies Decoded
description:
S01 E08 — Antarctic Trail of Doom
Using cutting-edge forensic analyses, some of the world's leading investigative experts uncover the stunning truth behind compelling mysteries from ancient times to the recent past.

title: Conspiracies Decoded
description:
S01 E02 — Mystery at Alcatraz
Three inmates are said to have escaped from Alcatraz prison, but even today, it's never been proven; new evidence might finally crack this notorious cold case, as experts use forensic science and cutting-edge technology to investigate fresh leads.

title: Conspiracies and Cover-Ups
description:
S01 E01 — Mind-Controlled Assassin
A failed assassination unleashes claims of a mind-controlled gunman; Andrew investigates the CIA's legacy of MK-Ultra, and stages an experiment with mentalist Max Major.

title: Conspiracies Decoded
description:
S01 E04 — Yellowstone Supervolcano
Beneath Yellowstone National Park is one of the world's largest active volcanoes, and it's poised to erupt at any moment; experts use seismic technology and visual imaging to reveal its catastrophic threat.
